meta.name: database-optimizer
meta.description: Optimizes database queries and improves performance across PostgreSQL and MySQL systems. Use when investigating slow queries, analyzing execution plans, or optimizing database performance. Invoke for index design, query rewrites, configuration tuning, partitioning strategies, lock contention resolution.

copy.tagline: 优化数据库查询，提升系统响应速度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理慢查询或数据库性能瓶颈
copy.tagline_en: Optimize database queries and boost system response speed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often deal with slow queries or database performance bottlenecks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成数据库优化专家，能分析慢查询、设计索引、调整配置、优化分区和解决锁竞争，并给出 SQL 代码和配置建议。
howto.when: 当你询问数据库查询慢、执行计划分析、索引设计或性能调优时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这条慢查询的 EXPLAIN ANALYZE 输出。
say.note: Claude 会解读执行计划并指出瓶颈。

say.text: 为 orders 表设计一个覆盖索引，减少堆读取。
say.note: Claude 会生成带 INCLUDE 的索引 SQL。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a database optimization specialist that can analyze slow queries, design indexes, tune configurations, optimize partitioning, and resolve lock contention, providing SQL code and configuration recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about slow database queries, execution plan analysis, index design, or performance tuning.

say_en.text: Analyze this slow query's EXPLAIN ANALYZE output.
say_en.note: Claude will interpret the plan and identify bottlenecks.

say_en.text: Design a covering index for the orders table to reduce heap fetches.
say_en.note: Claude will generate index SQL with INCLUDE columns.

say_en.text: How should I tune PostgreSQL's shared_buffers and work_mem?
say_en.note: Claude will give configuration advice based on your hardware.
